data_description.departure_interval: Seconds between updates per departure board. The API caches boards for 30 s.

user.title: Search stop
user.description: Leave empty to list stops near your home.

data.name: Name
data.hide_missed: Hide departures I can no longer catch

data_description.walk_minutes: Minutes from your door to the stop (default 5).
data_description.lines: Type a line (e.g. U9) and press Enter. Empty = all lines.
data_description.directions: Type a destination fragment (e.g. Osloer) and press Enter. Empty = all directions. Match if any fragment is contained.

api_unreachable.title: Transit API unreachable
api_unreachable.description: The API at {url} has not answered for several attempts. The last known connections are still shown and polling continues with a growing interval. If this persists, check the URL in the integration or use a self-hosted bvg-rest instance.
